recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up source work is needed unless the work group reintroduces a standalone Statistic datatype or changes the Evidence statistic count model.
issue_request: FHIR-30177 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked to change Statistic.numberOfEvents, Statistic.sampleSize.numberOfStudies, Statistic.sampleSize.numberOfParticipants, and Statistic.sampleSize.knownDataCount from integer to unsignedInt to prevent negative sample or event counts.
initial_application: Commit 9040dbb48bc7b4ccfb2451fb8724b69770e8eaf3, titled "Changes to the Evidence Resource and Statistic DataType and EvidenceReport Resource" and carrying J#30094 #J30177, changed the four rows in the then-current source/datatypes/statistic.xml spreadsheet from integer to unsignedInt.
additional_context: Statistic is no longer a standalone current datatype source. FHIR-31866 moved Statistic content into Evidence.statistic, and FHIR-31564 removed source/datatypes/statistic.xml. Evidence is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current Evidence StructureDefinition carries the four requested elements forward as unsignedInt. FHIR-31493 is an adjacent count-guidance issue already reconciled separately and does not change these four type requirements.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Editing the removed Statistic spreadsheet would be out of current build scope, and the active Evidence source already preserves the approved FHIR-30177 datatype requirements.
